name: KiwiKraft Performance
description: Precision engineered motorsport components from New Zealand.
story: KiwiKraft Performance has been crafting high-performance racing parts since 1985, initially focusing on rally components before expanding into circuit racing. They are driven by a passion for innovation and pushing the limits of motorsport technology. KiwiKraft seeks partnerships with teams demonstrating similar dedication to performance and a desire to showcase their components on a global stage.
